utterance_starts.first_words: Tiene la palabra el señor senador Giustiniani.
Señor presidente: en el mismo sentido, quiero plantear una cuestión de privilegio.
Tiene la palabra el señor senador González.

furniture_seen: top motto: “2015 - Año del Bicentenario del Congreso de los Pueblos Libres”
dateline: 27 de febrero de 2015 | Sesión preparatoria | Pág. 7
notes: The page opens inside a cuestión de privilegio already under way — the speaker is quoting his own earlier proyecto de resolución about suspending Amado Boudou — so that speech is not listed as a start; it ends with 'Queda planteada, señor presidente.' The long quoted resolución is inside that speaker's own words (he says 'este texto que acabo de leer'), so I did NOT treat it as an inserted document and it gets no speaker of its own. Headings are printed bold and flush left with a number, a full stop and a trailing full stop ('4. Cuestión de privilegio.'), not centred as in later years; I kept the printed form exactly. The label terminator is inconsistent on this page and I recorded each as printed, all as '.-': in 'Sr. Giustiniani.-' and 'Sr. González.-' the full stop is bold and part of the name, while in 'Sr. Presidente.-' the full stop and hyphen fall outside the bold. The chair is printed with no surname; none supplied. The last turn, González's, runs on past the foot of the page. No stenographer notes on this page.
